findings.problem: Identity is covered only in the negative and in 3rd person; 'I am / you are' (personal be-endings) has no entry, so a learner cannot say 'I'm a teacher' from this list.
findings.fix: Acceptable at count 10 since the endings form a 6-member set; note it in the report as the first item for a follow-up set.

findings.problem: Turkish marks politeness grammatically (sen vs siz) and that job is not covered; glue items were claimed before it.
findings.fix: sen/siz belong to the pronoun set, which does not fit in 10 slots; flag for a follow-up set rather than half-starting the set.
